opportunities.name: Tech lead research: HN search, GitHub repo stats, note
opportunities.description: For a given tech project name, find its top Hacker News story (points, age), then its GitHub repo (stars, latest release), and save a 'Lead:' note in the notes app.
steps: Search the project name on Hacker News (Algolia) and note the top story title, points, and age
Open GitHub, use the search bar to search the project name
Open the top matching repository and read stars and last release date
Open notes app, click New note, type 'Lead: <name>. HN "<title>" (<pts>, <age>); GitHub <stars> stars, last release <date>' and press Enter

instances.values: Bun (deno GitHub search at ~830 was started but not completed)

opportunities.name: Country fact-check: World Bank data + BBC news + note
opportunities.description: For a given country, look up World Bank indicator data and BBC news, then record a fact-check note.
steps: Search the country name in World Bank data search box
Search '<country> <topic>' on BBC News and open the top article
Add a 'Fact-check <country>' note in the notes app with the figure and headline

instances.values: Vietnam / Viet Nam, Vietnam climate, no note seen
Argentina, World Bank search only so far

opportunities.name: Company research: CourtListener case search + Wikipedia
opportunities.description: For a company name, search CourtListener for case law and Wikipedia for background, optionally drafting an email pitch.
steps: Enter company name in CourtListener keyword search and submit
Open the top case and read details
Search company name on Wikipedia and open the article
Optionally draft email with case and company facts
